answer.description: The complete answer for the user and Speechify. Do not include notebook metadata.

objective.description: The user's established current investigation. Empty if unknown; do not invent an objective.

observations.description: Still-relevant observations with explicit provenance. A user report or reference claim is not independently verified fact.

hypotheses.description: Unconfirmed explanations and candidate build paths, with their rationale and conditions.

decisions.description: Only choices the user actually made or that are directly visible. Advice alone is not a decision.

rejected_options.description: Rejected candidates and why, preserving who rejected them and any conditions.

next_tests.description: Concrete checks that would distinguish live alternatives.

source.description: An exact relevant user quote, identifiable visible screen detail, or file path and record/section. Do not fabricate a citation.
